title: N-Queens
inputFormat: Implement solveNQueens(n). Receive the board size and the exact number of queens to place.
outputFormat: Return every distinct valid board exactly once, in any outer order. Each board contains n row strings of length n using Q and .; row order is significant. Return [] if no arrangement exists.
